title: Define verification and record observed evidence
description: Verification engineers and reviewers can specify how a requirement criterion will be assessed and preserve what actually happened during that assessment. They can distinguish expected observations, actual results, incomplete execution, and unavailable support before drawing an engineering conclusion.

includes: Define requirement criteria, exact assessed subject state, technique, conditions, and expected observations.
Record identifiable assessment occurrences and actual observations with supporting evidence and provenance.
Keep plans, unperformed checks, partial assessments, failures to execute, and observed criterion failures distinguishable.
excludes: Automatically selecting all verification techniques or requiring CI.
Claiming satisfaction from a definition or result label alone.
Replacing evidence-applicability review or accountable engineering judgments.

sources.basis: IR-004 and SR-025 and SR-026 establish the distinct method and observation responsibilities needed before claim support can be judged.
